This file will add a column `EV` to raw MDMS data. The column will read either `TRUE` or `FALSE` depending on if the data contains kWh values that are known to coincide with EV charging. 

## Install

The following packages must be installed

* readr
* dplyr

### Usage

Set the `MERGE_EV` variable at the top of the file and run the cells. When combining EV data the labeling will overlap kWh usage with data from EV chargers during the same time windows. Where they overlap the `EV` value will be `TRUE`. 

When labeling non-EV data the column will always be `FALSE`. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# set this to TRUE for labeling EV data, FALSE for non-EV Data
MERGE_EV = TRUE

if(MERGE_EV)
{
  # use these paths when labeling EV data
  DIR_PATH = "raw_data/ev/"
  OUTPUT_PATH = "labeled_data/ev/"
} else {
  # use these paths when labeling EV data
  DIR_PATH = "raw_data/non-ev/"
  OUTPUT_PATH = "labeled_data/non-ev/"
}

WEATHER_DATA = "raw_data/weather_15_min.csv"

```

```{r}

# first list all primary metering files

primary_metering = list.files(path=DIR_PATH, pattern=".primary.csv$", full.names=TRUE)

```


```{r}

# 4 intervals per hour, 24 hrs * 365 days. -4 for FALL DST
TOTAL_INTERVALS = (4 * 24 * 365) - 4

# load weather data and rename column (https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/rename.html)
weather_df = read_csv(WEATHER_DATA, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
weather_df = weather_df %>% rename(start_full = datetime)
weather_df$start_full = as.POSIXct(weather_df$start_full, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago")

combine_ev_data = function(primary_file) {
  # every primary file should also have an ev meter file
  ev_file = sub(".primary.csv$", ".ev.csv", primary_file)
  
  primary_meter = read_csv(primary_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character(),
                                                          value = col_double(),
                                                          `vee-value` = col_double()))
  ev_meter = read_csv(ev_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character(),
                                                          value = col_double(),
                                                          `vee-value` = col_double()))
  
  # drop duplicate timestamps (should only be DST in FALL)
  primary_meter = primary_meter[!duplicated(primary_meter[c("start_full", "end_full")]), ]
  ev_meter = ev_meter[!duplicated(ev_meter[c("start_full", "end_full")]), ]
  
  # remove the final DST date (1:45am->1am)
  primary_meter <- primary_meter %>%
  mutate(
    start_dt = as.POSIXct(start_full, format = "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago"),
    end_dt   = as.POSIXct(end_full,   format = "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago")
  ) %>%
  filter(end_dt > start_dt)
  
  ev_meter <- ev_meter %>%
  mutate(
    start_dt = as.POSIXct(start_full, format = "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago"),
    end_dt   = as.POSIXct(end_full,   format = "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago")
  ) %>%
  filter(end_dt > start_dt)
  
  # check that there are enough rows (sanity check)
  if(nrow(primary_meter) == TOTAL_INTERVALS && nrow(primary_meter) == nrow(ev_meter))
  {
    # create EV true/false column based on 0.64 kWh value (refer to Raw Analysis)
    ev_meter$EV = ev_meter$value >= 0.64
    
    # create DF of ev labels for join
    join_df = ev_meter[c("start_full", "end_full", "EV")]
  
    # join with primary meter on timestamps
    # https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate-joins.html
    output_df = primary_meter %>%
        left_join(join_df, by = c("start_full", "end_full"))
    
    # make sure dates are datetime values
    output_df$start_full = as.POSIXct(output_df$start_full, format = "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago")
    
    #join weather data on timestamps
    output_df = output_df %>%
        left_join(weather_df, by=("start_full"))
    
    # only save if join was successful
    if(sum(is.na(output_df$EV)) == 0)
    {
      # save the labeled data
      output_file = sub(DIR_PATH, OUTPUT_PATH, primary_file)
      
      # convert dates back to chars, drop other columns
      output_df$start_full <- format(output_df$start_full, "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M")
      output_df = output_df %>% select(-c("start_dt", "end_dt"))
      
      write_csv(output_df, output_file)
    }
    else
    {
      warning("Failed to merge ", primary_file)
      FALSE
    }
    # return value
    TRUE
  } else { # return value
    warning("Row count mistmatch ", primary_file)
    FALSE
  }
  
}

non_ev_data = function(primary_file){
  # open the primary file and add the EV = FALSE label
  primary_meter = read_csv(primary_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character(),
                                                          value = col_double(),
                                                          `vee-value` = col_double()))
  
  # drop duplicate timestamps (should only be DST in FALL)
  primary_meter = primary_meter[!duplicated(primary_meter[c("start_full", "end_full")]), ]
  
  primary_meter <- primary_meter %>%
  mutate(
    start_dt = as.POSIXct(start_full, format = "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago"),
    end_dt   = as.POSIXct(end_full,   format = "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago")
  ) %>%
  filter(end_dt > start_dt)
  
  # make sure all the intervals exist and no NA values
  if(nrow(primary_meter) == TOTAL_INTERVALS && sum(is.na(primary_meter$value)) == 0)
  {
    # set EV value to FALSE
    primary_meter$EV = FALSE
    
    # make sure dates are datetime values
    primary_meter$start_full = as.POSIXct(primary_meter$start_full, format = "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M", tz = "America/Chicago")
    
    #join weather data on timestamps
    output_df = primary_meter %>%
        left_join(weather_df, by=("start_full"))
    
    # convert dates back to chars and drop other columns
    output_df$start_full <- format(output_df$start_full, "%m-%d-%Y %H:%M")
    output_df = output_df %>% select(-c("start_dt", "end_dt"))
    
    # save the labeled data
    output_file = sub(DIR_PATH, OUTPUT_PATH, primary_file)
    write_csv(output_df, output_file)
    
    # return value
    TRUE
  }
  else
  {
    warning("Row count mistmatch ", primary_file)
    FALSE
  }
}

if(MERGE_EV)
{
  # merge EV data
  combined_files = lapply(primary_metering, combine_ev_data)
} else {
  # add non-ev label
  combined_files = lapply(primary_metering, non_ev_data)
}

```

```{r}
# print the result - FALSE means a failure
combined_files
```
